translations.en: But Noah found favor in the eyes of YHWH.
translations.es: Pero Noé halló favor a los ojos de YHWH.

translations.ko: 이것은 노아의 내력이다. 노아는 의로운 사람이었고, 자기 세대 가운데 흠이 없었다. 노아는 하나님과 함께 걸었다.
translations.en: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among his generations. Noah walked with God.
translations.es: Estas son las generaciones de Noé. Noé era un hombre justo, íntegro entre sus generaciones. Noé caminaba con Dios.

translations.en: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
translations.es: La tierra estaba corrompida ante Dios, y la tierra estaba llena de violencia.

translations.en: God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
translations.es: Dios vio la tierra, y he aquí que estaba corrompida, porque toda carne había corrompido su camino sobre la tierra.
